title: Add document
purpose: Attach a document to an agreement: the executed copy, an amendment, a draft or correspondence.

items.label: Kind
items.description: Executed agreement, Amendment, Draft, Correspondence or Other. An attached executed copy lets the agreement be executed without a filing reference.

items.label: File
items.description: Required. PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT or CSV up to 10 MiB, checked by its content; downloaded only as a file. Do not upload consent forms, signatures or any document that identifies a participant.

items.label: Supersedes
items.description: Optional earlier document of this agreement that this one replaces; both stay listed.

items.label: Note
items.description: Optional. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Rules
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can open or submit this form; other roles are refused. The server repeats every check when you save.
The form opens in a dialog over the page you came from; opened directly it is a full page. Cancel returns to that page without saving.

Documents cannot be edited or removed; add a newer one that supersedes it. Signed agreements carry institution officials' names; that is professional data. Uploads are kept as data and never displayed in the page.
